title: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
script:
Nvidia just released the RTX Spark N1X processor for laptops and small desktops.
This chip uses an Arm-based architecture designed for high performance in compact devices.
Asus, HP, and Lenovo are already shipping devices featuring this new hardware.
The N1X chip integrates multiple high-speed cores for complex multitasking.
Initial testing highlights the platform's ability to run local AI tasks efficiently.
The Verge spent a week testing these machines across various professional workflows.
This hardware might finally make Windows on Arm a daily driver for power users. Would you switch your laptop to an Arm chip?
